pages.text: CO-328-02 1st printing Installing the Joysticks in Your Control Panel Since the Tetris game uses just the left, right, and down positions, your joysticks may be shipped with three microswitches each, not four. If your joysticks have only three microswitches mounted, make sure the side without the microswitch is closest to the player after the joystick is installed.
